discovery_notes: All evidence via search-engine summaries; page fetching not used. Ariel/Captain Hook Disney Pins Blog source is a headline seen in a summary; article URL not surfaced so the blog root is cited. Keys brush-of-magic/limited-edition/sorcerer-mickey and /maleficent were inferred from the naming pattern (not in todo list) - remap if engine uses different keys. Mickey Animator's Desk jumbo: summaries mention LE 3,749 and Oct 6 2026 availability but could not be attributed to a single publisher, so not claimed. Other WDW 2026 Windows of Attraction pins seen: Enchanted Tiki Room = 10 of 12, LE 2500, $26.99, Oct 13 2026 (disneyblog.com/news/walt-disney-world-reveals-october-2026-pin-releases/); Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin = 8 of 12, LE 2500, $26.99 (wdwnt August 2026 WDW pin releases article). Haunted Mansion = 1 of 12 (wdwnt). Not added as pins (not requested; keys unknown). | Key remapped by orchestrator: sorcerer-mickey → mickey-mouse-sorcerer.
